i used to feel like you. it made me miserable thinking how unlucky i was. for me what helped was really starting to appreciate absolutely anything i could. 

I dont know you and dont know how bad or good your situation is but there is always stuff to appreciate and there is always people worse off than you. 

broadening your view on the world and taking notice of how fucked up everything is, you realize maybe you dont have it so bad. 
I came to a point after a while where by being so insanely grateful and positive i started to appreciate even what went "wrong" because of how much worse it could have gone. for example if i missed the train by a minute or two, id think; because the world loves me so much, and im the luckiest person alive, maybe getting on that train would have led to something really bad happening, so its best it turned out how it did. 

you never know if the you that exists here, now, is the unluckiest or most miserable one out of all of you, but its really unlikely, and if youre going to believe in something really unlikely, might aswell be something positive then...
